Organization: Soldiers' Angels — Monthly Military & Veteran Food Distribution
Address: University Methodist Church, 5185 De Zavala Rd, San Antonio, TX 78249 (office/HQ is at 1355 Central Pkwy S Ste 700, San Antonio, TX 78232)
What they offer: Monthly food distribution of about 75 lbs. of groceries at no cost. Registration is required each month. Office phone: 210-629-0020.
Who qualifies: Service members and veterans in need in the San Antonio area. Register with documentation such as a military ID, VA ID, or DD-214, and bring that documentation to the event.
Schedule: Typically the third Thursday of the month, 12-2 p.m. CT. Remaining 2026 dates listed on the Soldiers' Angels site include Nov 19 and Dec 17.

Organization: Soldiers' Angels — Military & Veteran Food Pantry
Address: 1355 Central Pkwy S #700, San Antonio, TX 78232
What they offer: Weekly food pantry, in partnership with Boeing, with fresh produce, frozen goods, and pantry staples. Registration is required each month. Office phone: 210-629-0020.
Who qualifies: Military and veteran families facing food insecurity in the San Antonio area. Register with documentation such as a military ID, VA ID, or DD-214, and bring that documentation to the event.
Schedule: Every Friday except the third Friday of the month, 12-3 p.m. CT.

Address: Official address: 2490 Stanley Road, Building 367, JBSA-Fort Sam Houston, TX 78234. (A map pin at 1777 I-410 sometimes appears online; use the Stanley Road address and be prepared for base access.)
What they offer: No-cost culinary classes and nutrition coaching for DoD ID holders. Non-perishable food pantry by appointment (Room 143). Monthly on-site / drive-thru style food distributions in collaboration with the San Antonio Food Bank. Center email: usarmy.jbsa.arnorth.mbx.vogel-resiliency-center@army.mil.
Who qualifies: Culinary/nutrition programs: active duty and dependents, retirees, DoD civilian employees, Guard and Reserve; all services are no-cost. Food distributions: military members, veterans, civilians, and Gold Star families. BASE ACCESS IS REQUIRED.
Schedule: Center: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-4 p.m. (closed federal holidays). Pantry: by appointment, Monday-Friday 6-10 a.m. and Tuesday-Wednesday 1-4 p.m. Monthly food distributions are typically morning hours, while supplies last; check current dates with the center or San Antonio Food Bank / FreshTrak before you go.

Organization: Good Samaritan Veterans Outreach & Transition Center (GSVOTC)
Address: 202 Connelly St, San Antonio, TX 78203. Phone: 210-486-2185. Email: spc-gsvotc@alamo.edu.
What they offer: No-cost personalized services and referrals for claims and benefits (Texas Veterans Commission), emergency housing (Endeavors), employment and transition, financial assistance (Bexar County Help2Vets), education benefits, and a legal clinic (San Antonio Legal Services Association, typically the second Friday of the month). The center is primarily a support and referral hub. Periodic community meals have been hosted there, but it is not a standing daily meal program — call ahead if you are looking for a meal.
Who qualifies: Active duty, transitioning service members, veterans, National Guard, Reservists, and their family members in the greater San Antonio area.
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-5 p.m. Some partner services are walk-in; others are by appointment. Legal clinic is typically the second Friday of the month.

Address: Serves Texas veterans; mailing address PO Box 1024, Fredericksburg, TX 78624. Phone: 830-992-3375 or 800-676-1389. Email: info@mealsforvets.org.
What they offer: Delivered nutritious meals for low- or no-income Texas veterans who do not qualify for other food programs such as Meals on Wheels. As of the organization's apply page, the program may be operating with a waitlist due to high demand.
Who qualifies: Texas veterans with limited financial resources and proof of at least 1 day of active-duty service. Income limits apply. Apply online or by phone.
Schedule: Ongoing program (not a Veterans Day-only offer). Complete an application; the organization contacts applicants for intake. Check the website for current waitlist status.
